editorialDecl.p: The initial transcription file was a plain text file in Unicode. The original transcription guidelines can be found at
The initial transcriptions were reconciled by Rachel Kevern. The plain text file was converted to XML by Hugh Houghton and Catherine Smith using the project's Python conversion scripts 1.0.
The XML specifications used are version 1.6 of the IGNTP Guidelines available at
